thesis: Kinds and domains of laws must be distinguished before assessing truth.
role: Map dynamics, probabilities, constraints and effective theories.

ideas.statement: Dynamical, probabilistic, conservation, constitutive, scaling and impossibility claims demand different tests and retained premises.
Effective theories systematically organize relevant effects; mathematical rigor or definitional identity does not by itself establish empirical causation.
